name: resolve-signed-workspace-gap-analyze-high-gaps
title: Resolve signed-workspace gaps and gitRoot repair UX
description: Resolve signed-workspace gap_analyze highs and add a deterministic gitRoot repair UX for wrapper-root projects where Lattice metadata lives above the git material repo. The repair must be explicit, fail closed for ambiguous nested repos, and must not auto-spawn host agents or silently guess signedWorkspaceRoot.
